body: The core wound fuses with identity and vitality; healing your sense of self and becoming yourself are the same project.
business: You help others accept themselves because you did that work.
shadow: Defining yourself by the wound, or dimming your light to keep it hidden.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Authored from supplied modern-point aspect file.
